concept: From Green Bean to First Pour
recommendations: Treat intensity five as maximum meaningful transformation with calm internal holds, not continuous competing movement.
Let the visitor's roast profile change content and material across the catalogue, roast chamber, brew guide, and subscription.
Keep the central roast chamber as the clearest spatial peak even though every section has a signature mechanism.

sections.title: Navigation
sections.role: Orient and expose live roast state
sections.inputState: Route position and selected roast profile
sections.endState: Compact thermal rail with current chapter
sections.connection: Carries roast temperature and section position across the route
sections.desktop: Pinned horizontal rail transforms as chapters change
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors retain direct task access while seeing roast progress.

sections.title: Hero
sections.role: Orient the visitor inside the roast journey
sections.connection: Creates the profile state used before, during, and after the peak
sections.desktop: Spatial chamber entrance with profile control
sections.reducedMotion: Resolved product rendering and profile buttons
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The visitor selects how the product journey should develop.

sections.title: Story and stats
sections.role: Prove the machine, scale, farm relationships, and dispatch promise
sections.endState: 1962 machine blueprint resolves into four facts
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The page visibly connects Northwind's physical constraints to its claims.

sections.title: Bean catalogue
sections.startState: Origins orbit around the selected roast
sections.endState: Focused coffee opens as a dimensional batch card
sections.mechanismOwner: React state and GSAP spatial rail
sections.connection: Makes the selected profile affect product emphasis
sections.desktop: Depth-based finite gallery with keyboard controls
sections.mobile: Native snap rail with bounded depth
sections.meaningfulOutcome: All six products remain legible and purchasable while origin relationships become spatial.

sections.title: Roast transformation
sections.role: Explain charge, drying, first crack, development, and drop
sections.startState: Green beans enter a cold 1962 Probat drum
sections.endState: Roasted beans fall into cooling air with a shipping timestamp
sections.connection: Central peak converts earlier choice into visible physical change
sections.desktop: Pinned rendered drum with camera, bean material, heat and geometry transformation
sections.mobile: Shorter staged chamber with touch controls and safe release
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors understand why roast development and rapid dispatch change the coffee.

sections.title: Brew guide
sections.role: Turn roast precision into a usable four-step recipe
sections.startState: Tools appear as an exploded preparation layout
sections.endState: A completed pour resolves into brew time
sections.connection: Reuses temperature and time as practical instruction
sections.desktop: Scroll-authored scale, grinder, bloom and pour sequence
sections.mobile: Tap/scroll step instrument with persistent timer
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The four original steps become easier to perform.

sections.title: Subscriber reviews
sections.role: Prove freshness through subscriber dispatch records
sections.endState: Three voices unfold around receipt timestamps
sections.connection: Transforms shipping records into human proof
sections.desktop: Layered dispatch notes unfold in sequence
sections.mobile: Direct-manipulation stack with full readable quotes
sections.meaningfulOutcome: All three testimonials remain readable and feel causally tied to freshness.

sections.title: Subscription
sections.role: Resolve profile choice into a recurring delivery
sections.endState: Personalized dispatch crate seals for shipment
sections.mechanismOwner: React state and GSAP packaging sequence
sections.connection: Shows the downstream consequence of the initial choice
sections.reducedMotion: Resolved subscription pack with profile copy
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The $29 offer feels like the completion of the selected journey.

sections.title: Contact
sections.role: Connect directly with the two-person roastery
sections.endState: Message transmits and receives a reply-time confirmation
sections.mechanismOwner: React state and CSS signal motion
sections.connection: Returns the spatial system to a human-scale exchange
sections.desktop: Console fields activate a bounded transmission visualization
sections.mobile: Single-column radio panel with large controls
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Validation and success feedback become unmistakable without obstructing the form.

sections.title: Footer
sections.role: Close the batch ledger and preserve legal routes
sections.startState: Cooling line carries the final batch
sections.endState: Dispatch stamp resolves with four routes
sections.connection: Completes the temperature signal as a shipping timestamp
sections.desktop: Cooling rail transforms into final identity and links
sections.mobile: Vertical dispatch receipt with accessible routes
sections.meaningfulOutcome: The journey ends with preserved identity and all footer destinations.
